title: Use company paid-break settings across hours screens
public_pr_body:
Working hours deducted fixed unpaid breaks even when the company's Hours setting paid them. Read the existing saved company time settings for planned day/week totals and use the same explanation on the daily hours sheet. Missing settings show no paid-hours preview; JNR defaults remain unpaid. No new setting, SQL or pay-rate logic.

Claim: N1. Searched main and open PRs; the company setting already existed, but this preview connection did not. No docs files changed.

Validation: 39 tests passed (company-paid-breaks, working-hours, time-sheet); TypeScript and targeted ESLint passed. Browser/database tests not run (no disposable database); no SQL applied.
